 "edit": {"DEPTH": 6, "WARMUP_RATIO": 0.05, "TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9"},
 "description": "Discard leaked 0-10 run; test DEPTH 4->6 plus WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 on clean shards 0-9, combining teammates' validated gains",

Flagging so final rankings aren't misleading; please clarify shard rules or note this on the board."}
